sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appeal is yet to be formally admitted on record.

An application has been preferred on behalf of the appellant under Section 389 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 ('Cr.P.C') for suspension of sentence and release on bail during pendency of appeal in FIR No. 172/2016 under Sections 323/376 IPC registered at PS: Pandav Nagar.

sentences.text: In brief, as per the case of the prosecution, on 26.03.2016, the prosecutrix made a call to the police regarding committing of wrong act.
Investigation was thereupon commenced and prosecutrix was got medically examined and her statement was recorded.
She alleged that she works as a maid servant and around 10 PM after finishing her work while she was returning back to her house.
On her way back, the appellant forcibly took her to his house and committed sexual assault.

Statement of prosecutrix was also got recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C.
4.

Learned counsel for the appellant while referring to paragraph 24 of the judgment submits that evidence of the prosecutrix has been incorrectly appreciated by the learned trial court as presumption under Section 114 of the Indian Evidence Act could not have been raised.

He also submits that relations between the parties were not cordial since there was a dispute with regard to an amount of Rs.2,50,000/- owed by the husband of the appellant, who was working as an auto driver with appellant.
It is also submitted that there are other inconsistencies in the testimony of the prosecutrix.

Reliance is also placed upon Ashish Windwani v. State (NCT of Delhi), 2022 SCC OnLine 3314.
5.

entities.text: Ashish Windwani v. State (NCT of Delhi), 2022 SCC OnLine 3314

sentences.text: On the other hand, the application has been opposed by the learned APP for the State and is submitted that the testimony of the prosecutrix is consistent and trustworthy.
The sexual assault is stated to be supported by FSL result.
6. Apparently the FSL result duly supports the factum of sexual assault.
It cannot be ignored that the telephonic call regarding sexual assault had been made on behalf of the prosecutrix immediately after the incident and as such This is a digitally signed order.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and evidence on record, no grounds for suspension of sentence are made out at this stage.
The application is dismissed.
Nothing stated herein shall tantamount to expression of opinion on merits of the case.
